assign.request: Two merges from the overlap study: wire ux/Filter into core/Sidebar's tree (typing narrows rows, keeping ancestors visible; clear restores fold; Escape clears), and make ext/grip the one resize-rail implementation for both core/Sidebar and /layouts/shell/Shell.js, deleting the two copied grab() gestures.
assign.now: reading ux/Filter, core/Sidebar, ext/grip, layouts/shell/Shell.js and their docs before the first edit
steps: read ux/Filter (readme, Filter.js, FilterChips.js, page.js) and core/Sidebar (Sidebar.js, Sidebar.css, readme, doc/decisions.md)
read ext/grip (grip.js, grip.css, readme, doc/decisions.md), its two live consumers (ext/drawer, dev/DevBar), and layouts/shell/Shell.js + shell.css + page.js's size_rail()

design the tree-filter wire: Filter composed with segments: [] (search-only), search_field: 'text' matching ux/Tree's node shape; Sidebar owns matching + ancestor-visibility + fold-state save/restore since ux/Tree has no filter hook of its own
add the smallest seam ux/Filter is missing: an Escape-clears-the-query behaviour, hoisting FilterChips' clear_query() up to the base Filter class so both the key and a chip's x share one method

extend ext/grip with an optional reset callback wired to dblclick (the one behaviour the two copied grab()s have that grip does not); make done() optional since Shell's page.size_rail() already persists on every write
rewrite Sidebar.grab() and Shell.grab() to call grip(), delete both custom pointer-capture blocks and their CSS, adopt grip.css's own strip/pill for both rails
prove headless on PORT=8133: filter row counts before/after three letters typed, clear restores fold, Escape clears; both rails resize/remember/reset; zero console errors at 400/1280/3440
documentation pass: core/Sidebar/readme.md, ux/Filter/readme.md, ext/grip/readme.md, layouts/shell/readme.md, dated entries in the three doc/decisions.md

Zero console/page errors at 400/1280/3440 on that page and five others (/, /framework/, /layouts/shell/, ux/Filter, ext/grip).

grip merge proof: core/Sidebar demo (fixed inline width, outside .topic, so --sidebar-w never reaches a rendered size there) -- token '' -> '287px' on drag, localStorage {px:287}, dblclick reset -> '' / {px:null}. Real site nav on /framework/ (inside .topic): 241px -> 348px on drag, dblclick -> 241px exactly. /layouts/shell/ rail: 288px -> 375px on drag, dblclick -> 288px exactly.

grip merge line count, measured hunk-by-hunk against the exact text each Edit call matched: Sidebar.js grab() 23->16, Sidebar.css .sidebar-grab block 25->7 (+1->5 narrow-mode line), Shell.js grab($track) 24->15, shell.css .std-shell-grab block 26->5 (+2->7 narrow-mode line), plus one new import line in each .js file. 101 lines of old pointer-capture code+CSS deleted, 57 added, net -44 -- bigger than the overlap study's ~30-line estimate because that estimate never counted either file's CSS.

left open, with reasons: (1) a lazy/unopened branch's title is the only thing the filter can search -- searching its unloaded children would fetch a whole subtree per keystroke; (2) keyboard arrow-nav can still step onto a row the filter hid, because ux/Tree's own moves() reads DOM class not visibility -- the real fix needs a ux/Tree hook and ux/Tree is out of fence, actively edited by ai/2026-09-18/tree-fixes today; (3) three other files (apidoc/page.js, theme/lew42/page.js, styles/layouts/sidebar/page.js) still read the shared --sidebar token instead of a live Sidebar's resized width -- pre-existing drift, named in Sidebar's own 2026-09-18 decisions.md before this task, outside this fence.

assign.outcome:
![the filter narrowing the tree to JS > Syntax](sidebar-filter.png)

**Both merges from the overlap study landed.** `ux/Filter` (151 lines, zero callers before today) is now the search box above `core/Sidebar`'s tree: typing narrows rows to titles that match, keeping every branch that leads to a match open and visible; clearing the box — or Escape, a seam added to `Filter` itself so every caller gets it — restores the fold exactly as the reader left it. Headless proof on the module's own "five levels" demo: **12 rows visible, narrowed to 2** on typing `syn` (`JS` the ancestor, `Syntax` the match), back to 12 on Escape with `JS` still open; zero console errors at 400/1280/3440 across six pages. `core/Sidebar`'s and `/layouts/shell/Shell.js`'s copied resize-drag gesture is now one shared `ext/grip` call in each — `ext/grip` gained the one thing it was missing (an optional `reset`, for double-click) and made `done` truly optional. **101 lines of hand-copied pointer-capture code and CSS deleted, 57 added — net 44 lines shorter**, bigger than the study's own ~30-line estimate because that one never counted either file's CSS. Both rails proved resizing, remembering (localStorage) and double-click reset, headless, on a real in-page nav sidebar and the shell's own rail.
